title: How Are You?
label: ch:responding
canDo: I can ask how someone is in Hindi, answer naturally, and return the question.

payoff.summary: Complete HI-C03-practice, the canonical closing checkpoint, and demonstrate the chapter promise: ask how someone is in Hindi, answer naturally, and return the question.
payoff.note: Chapter 3 is schema-v2, so the payoff is atom-scored: HI-C03-practice assesses 4 of the chapter's 7 atoms — the two set phrases (aap kaise hain, aapka swagat hai), thik, and the full exchange the checkpoint introduces. The three building blocks kaise, main and hun are rehearsed inside those phrases and scored in their own lessons rather than as separate checkpoint atoms.
